Calorie Pewar Android preview — testing only, not a launch release.

- Includes local tracking, regional foods, and Arabic/Kurdish Sorani interfaces.
- Choose the offline/guest option. Login, cloud backup, and AI are unavailable in this unconfigured preview.
- Installs separately from FitTrack. Your existing installation and records are not migrated or replaced. Do not uninstall FitTrack to try this preview.
- Uses a temporary test signing key. Later previews may require a separate installation; export and verify any preview data you want to retain before removing one.
- Automated checks and signature verification do not replace physical-device testing. Reminder behavior, Sorani dates, and other release checks remain unfinished.
- Android 9 or later is required. No Firebase Admin credentials, Gemini keys, or private production signing keys are included.
